name: scanner-timeout
description: The dependency scanner reported an ETIMEDOUT error result (it timed out before producing any advisory data). Both implementations must treat it as an errored mandatory scanner: a hard FAIL is forced by blockOnScannerError (default), and even with it off the coverage must be INCOMPLETE — never a clean pass. The same evidence feeds both the Rust gate and the TS gate.

notes: dependency coverage is incomplete, not a pass
